subject: MAP: Acme Healthcare - Updated timeline and reforecast

Cc: Lee Chen <lee.chen@acmehealthcare.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft and post-call recap — Acme Healthcare

Hi Samantha / Lee,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for taking the time to walk through Acme's migration priorities and constraints. As discussed, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align milestones, owners, and a target close date. High-level recap below: 

Summary of next steps (from today's discovery):
- Pilot scope: 1 clinical workload (appointment scheduling) + embeddings for search
- Success criteria: <80ms 95th-percentile latency for retrieval path; function-call integration with EHR via API
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, legal review of SOW, network allowlist for Private deployment
- Proposed target close date: 2026-07-30 (tentative)

Attached: Acme_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (milestones/responsibilities)

Please review the MAP and call out any mismatches in owners or timing. If that target close date is aggressive for your budgeting/procurement cycles we can reforecast — just let me know the timing you expect and we'll adjust.

Next suggested items:
1) Confirm pilot owner on Acme side (technical sponsor)
2) Legal to review SOW excerpt (attached)
3) Kickoff readiness call targeted the week of 6/22 if timing holds

Thanks — I’ll follow up next week after you’ve had a chance to review.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and post-call recap — Acme Healthcare

Marissa — thanks for the thorough recap and the MAP draft. Team reviewed and we have a few internal constraints that will push the timeline out:

- Procurement: Our Q3 budget holds are uncertain and the earliest purchasing window is mid-August.
- Prioritization: Execs reprioritized the roadmap — they approved a pilot but requested a phased rollout with a smaller initial pilot.

Can we reforecast the target close to 2026-09-15 and update milestones accordingly (split pilot into Pilot A / Pilot B)? That will give legal and procurement time to complete reviews.

We also need the following from Redwood before we can commit:
- Confirmation on SOC 2 readiness and approximate timeline for evidence
- A trimmed pilot plan that limits integration surface for Pilot A (API-only, no on-prem agent)

If you can update the MAP and resend with new milestones and dates we can confirm owners and get procurement engaged.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Digital Transformation
Acme Healthcare
samantha.ortiz@acmehealthcare.com
Office: (617) 555-0199

Marissa — thanks for the heads up. Re: phased pilot and new target close (2026-09-15), high-level notes:

- Feasibility: Pilot A (API-only) is feasible. We can scope Pilot A for a single clinical workflow and hit the latency target if we run the model on Hosted Redwood inference with a dedicated instance during the pilot window. On-prem agent only required for Pilot B if they want full network isolation.
- Suggested milestone changes:
  * Milestone 1 (Pilot A readiness): API integration + metrics instrumentation — target 2026-07-26
  * Milestone 2 (Pilot A validation): performance run + acceptance (P0 fixes) — target 2026-08-16
  * Milestone 3 (Procurement sign-off & SOW): legal review complete — target 2026-08-30
  * Milestone 4 (Pilot B planning): scope for on-prem / Private deployment — target 2026-09-10
  * Target close / contract execution: 2026-09-15
- Dependencies and owners:
  * Redwood eng (Rishi) – provide API integration guide, perf-run support, and hosted instance config
  * Acme eng (TBD) – provide API endpoints + test data
  * Legal/procurement (Acme) – SOW redline and PO issuance
- SOC 2: We can share our SOC 2 Type II report; current attestation is in place and I can provide an evidence package to Acme by 6/19.
- Risk: If procurement requests longer review, the contract execution may slip beyond 9/15; recommend we build in a 2-week contingency in the MAP.

I'll prepare a short appendix for Pilot A that trims integration steps — can have a draft by Monday.

Rishi

Updated high-level MAP (summary):
- Target close: 2026-09-15 (goal)
- Pilot A (API-only, hosted):
  * Owner (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra — provide API integration guide, hosted instance config, and perf support
  * Owner (Acme): TBA — provide API endpoints and test payloads
  * Milestone 1 (API integration): target 2026-07-26
  * Milestone 2 (Pilot A validation): performance run and acceptance — target 2026-08-16
- Procurement & Legal:
  * Acme legal review of SOW: target 2026-08-30
  * Redwood to provide SOC 2 evidence package: by 2026-06-19 (shared via secure link)
- Pilot B planning (Private/on-prem): scope/requirements document by 2026-09-10
- Contingency: added 2-week buffer to contract execution milestone in case procurement extends review

Attachments and links:

- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
